subject: a lean Dutch painter in his thirties with short cropped reddish-ginger hair and a short ginger beard, pale intent eyes, wearing a rough blue workman's jacket and a battered straw hat, 1880s clothing

panels.01-goupil: a serious sixteen-year-old Dutch boy in a dark 1869 suit and stiff collar arranging framed prints on the wall of an elegant art dealer's gallery in The Hague, gilt frames, an older dealer in a frock coat watching, soft window light, 19th-century Netherlands
panels.02-cuesmes: a thin young man of 27 in a worn dark coat sitting on a wooden stool in a poor Belgian coal miner's cottage in 1880, drawing a tired miner and his family by lamplight on a sheet of paper with a stick of charcoal, pithead and slag heaps visible through the small window, quiet determination
panels.03-dunes: {S} without the straw hat, wearing a cap, standing at a small wooden field easel on windswept sand dunes near the North Sea coast in 1882, painting with thick brushstrokes, the wind tugging at his coat, fishing boats on the beach in the distance, grey sky, first oil studies, at work outdoors
panels.04-nuenen: {S} in a dark coat sketching a Dutch handloom weaver at work inside a dim thatched cottage in Nuenen in 1885, the large wooden loom filling the room, a small window, earthy browns, sketchbook on his knee, respectful quiet
panels.05-paris: {S} in a city jacket sitting at a folding easel on the grassy bank of the Seine at Asnières near Paris in 1887, painting in small bright dabs of colour, a riverside restaurant, rowing boats and a bridge behind him, summer light, a friend with a sketchbook beside him
panels.06-arles: {S} in a straw hat standing at a wooden easel staked against the strong mistral wind in an open golden wheat field near Arles in Provence in summer 1888, painting fast with a loaded brush, paint box at his feet, farmhouses and blue hills on the horizon, blazing southern sun, intense concentration, at work outdoors
panels.07-saintremy: {S} in a straw hat painting at a field easel among gnarled olive trees on a dry hillside near Saint-Rémy in Provence in 1889, low stone walls and the rocky Alpilles hills behind, an old asylum attendant in a cap waiting patiently in the shade, bright daylight, calm focus
panels.08-letters: {S} without hat seated at a small wooden table in a narrow attic room of a village inn at Auvers-sur-Oise in 1890, writing a long letter to his brother by the light of a small window, a steel-nib pen and inkpot, small sketches drawn in the margins of the letter, canvases stacked against the wall with their backs facing out, quiet summer evening
